source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
source.original_treatment_name: Rhus microphylla Engelm. ex A. Gray

morphology_documented.habit: Much-branched shrub, rarely small tree, to ca. 5 m, usually much smaller
morphology_documented.leaves: Pinnately compound; (3–)5–9 small leaflets <2 cm long and <6 mm wide, sessile, pilose; rachis winged
morphology_documented.flowers: Appearing before leaves, rarely with them

source_scope_note: Only traits documented in cited flora; null/omitted traits not inferred. Genus-key traits indicated where relevant.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Key states small leaflet dimensions and branches often spinescent; do not infer true spines on every specimen
preservation: Additive research record; original species.json, photos, credits, and galleries unchanged
